note: Rio Grande NF (Conejos Peak RD) in the Conejos River canyon at ~8,700 ft, on a bench inside a bend of the river; most sites look up at the canyon's cliff walls. Small Spectacle Lake (entering the lake is prohibited by forest order) is across FR 250 from the campground; fishing access to the river and the lake. Access via CO-17 then 6.3 mi on dirt FR 250. October 2026: flood damage on FR 250 between Stunner and CO-17, where the Forest Service recommends 4WD until repaired. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 24 sites (13 pull-through), vault toilets, FCFS (no recreation.gov listing; fee envelopes), phone 719-274-8971 (Conejos Peak RD). Changed potable_water true -> false ('Potable water is not available at this site'). Added season (Memorial Day - Labor Day weekend), 14-night forest limit. No length stated anywhere. Fees left (the page's fee text contradicts itself). Note cleaned: field facts and the hand-pump water claim dropped.
flags: Road (temporary, October 2026 floods): the Rio Grande NF conditions page (updated 2026-10-28) says 'FSR 250 between Stunner to Highway 17 has damage - 4WD is recommended' - that is this campground's access road (6.3 mi of FR 250 from CO-17). The district road-status table (last updated 2026-05-29) still lists 250 Conejos Canyon and 250.7B Spectacle Lake Campground 'Open'. The campground is closed for the season anyway ('Closed for the season- Will resume Memorial Day weekend 2027'), so no status written; recheck the road before spring.

Fees: the FS page's fee box contradicts itself - 'Single Site: $29 per night | Single Site Hookup: $31 per night' and then 'Single Site - $26 to $30.' Nothing on the page describes any hookup, and there is no potable water; stored 26-31 left alone. Base is probably $29, but the page does not settle it.
Potable water: the old note said 'developed water with 2 hand pumps'; the FS amenity table says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Written as false.
Length: the FS page states no maximum length; 13 pull-throughs of 24 sites. No review check done (the agency is silent, not singling it out).

Waterfront (stored lakeview): on imagery Spectacle Lake is a ~150 x 110 m pond on the NORTH side of FR 250 with a dock/day-use pullout on its south shore; the campground loops sit south of the road inside the Conejos River bend. Only the loop nearest the road (~100 m from the pond across the road and open scrub) can see the pond; the Conejos (~20-30 m wide) runs 150-200 m west through trees, a side channel ~80-100 m east. lakeview is marginal but not contradicted; left.
Pin: stored 37.16836,-106.43918 = the FS page's coordinates, at the campground entrance off FR 250; the loops' centre is ~230 m south (about 37.1663,-106.4385). Within 500 m.
